name: implement
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the model-backed implement-then-PR doer (DESIGN §3.6.2/§3.6.3) replaces the dry-run reference adapter, or when the Handoff schema reaches a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: v0.11.1: open_pr.py setup_worktree now runs the worktree add HOOKS-FREE via `git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null worktree add ...` so the target repo's post-checkout hook (e.g. ssbdci-grimlock's render_nested_components) never fires in the implementer's disposable worktree — mirrors verify-integrate's reconcile/GATE hooks-off fix. All other setup_worktree behavior unchanged (resolve default branch, git fetch origin <default>, start-point origin/<default> never local HEAD, gh pr create --base <default>). PRIOR v0.11.0: moved the shipped implementer's worktree-setup + PR-open from PROMPT-TIER git/gh prose into a DETERMINISTIC companion script src/open_pr.py (spec-rules §4 Script-Backed Orchestration), fixing the live wrong-base STACKED PR bug (#844 based on #831's branch, #846 on #844's) that a back-to-back drain burst produced. The script UNCONDITIONALLY resolves the repo default branch (gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef), git fetch origin <default>, git worktree add <wt> -b <branch> origin/<default> (start-point ALWAYS the fresh remote ref, NEVER local HEAD), and gh pr create --base <default> (explicit base, never inferred/tracked); it has an injectable runner for deterministic tests. Rewrote the agent .md (v2.10.0->v2.11.0) to INVOKE the script at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/open_pr.py (deployed convention, like test_gate.py) in place of the raw git/gh base prose; own-worktree isolation + all other steps (test_gate, self-review, supersede, regen, Closes #<n>) preserved. contract.md 0.7.0->0.8.0 adds open_pr.py to provides.scripts + invokes. Housekeep doc baseline re-anchored in-scope (spec.md 355->378, contract.md 35->36). NOTE follow-on: packaging-config build_plugin _LIBS must register lib/open_pr.py (mirroring test_gate.py) so it deploys — a separate packaging release, out of this feature's scope. spec.md was authored/committed by the dispatcher spec-update phase.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md already advanced to 0.11.1 (hooks-free worktree add wording) by the dispatcher spec-update phase before this cycle; this cycle implements that spec change in open_pr.py
